general_summary: Based in Porto, the office has over 20 years of experience dedicated to Architecture, Urban Planning and Design, working both in the public and the private sector, in diferent areas, themes and scales of intervention. Formed by architects with different professional backgrounds, we are always ready to take up any challenge with rigor and professionalism, envisaging the workspace as a research laboratory in order to search for innovative solutions which are able to address a society in constant mutation. With a contemporary culture and great enthusiasm for the principles of sustainability, each project is developed in a comprehensive way, both technical and theoretical, without preconceptions, stimulating creativity throughout the design process, given the specificity of linking each construction and its design to its context and function, creating a consistent work method. Alfredo Resende provides its clients and the entities involved in each project with a strong working relationship, ensuring a perfect performance and monitoring of all phases of the project.

Private practice in Portugal since 1983. Before that, in Brazil since 1977. Long experience in residential design, both single- and multi-family buildings. A good know-how in designing for tropical climates and low-cost construction. Some experience also in small hotels and restaurants.
